title: University of Cincinnati Campus Landscape
subtitle: A pedestrian campus organized through connected open spaces

links.label: Campus planning history — University of Cincinnati
Campus scope and design history — Places

description: Hargreaves Associates developed the University of Cincinnati’s campus master plan, approved in 1991, and a series of landscape projects over the following two decades. Connected quadrangles, lawns and pedestrian routes replaced roads and surface parking. Landforms and changes in level give the open spaces distinct characters while linking the campus as a whole. The approximately 200-acre figure describes the campus planning context, rather than the area of any single recorded space.

title: Fountain Square
subtitle: A downtown civic plaza centered on the Tyler Davidson Fountain
description: Fountain Square is a civic gathering place in downtown Cincinnati, centered on the historic Tyler Davidson Fountain. OLIN’s revitalization relocated the fountain to open up space for events and seating, with planting and street trees defining the plaza’s edges. The square reopened in 2006; OLIN lists the project as completed in 2007.

title: Luxelakes CPI Island
subtitle: Lakeside public spaces within a renewed cluster of former show homes
description: CPI Island is a lakeside retail landscape at Luxelakes in Chengdu. Completed in 2024, the landscape renewal by Yudao Studio retains mature planting and works with approximately nine metres of level change. Paths connect former show homes, small courtyards, terraces and lakeside spaces, opening up an established landscape for public use. The published landscape project covers approximately 30,000 square metres; later phases have separate design teams and boundaries.

title: Luxelakes Love Island
subtitle: A lakeside setting for outdoor ceremonies
description: Love Island (爱心岛) is a heart-shaped island within Luxelakes in Chengdu, published as Edenland in the landscape designer’s project documentation. Its lakeside gardens, lawns and paths provide settings for ceremonies and recreation. Interesting Landscape completed the 11,388-square-metre island landscape in 2024. This archive entry focuses on an open-sided pitched-roof pavilion and its surrounding outdoor space.

title: Circo Massimo
description: Circo Massimo occupies a long valley between Rome’s Palatine and Aventine hills. The former chariot-racing ground now forms a large open space within the historic city, with archaeological remains at its southeastern end.

title: Portland International Airport Main Terminal
description: Portland International Airport’s reconstructed main terminal is organized beneath an undulating mass-timber roof. Skylights, interior planting and a pre-security market hall introduce daylight and places to pause within the airport’s public circulation spaces. The main hall opened in 2024, with the remaining reconstruction completed in 2026.

title: Freeway Park
subtitle: Concrete plazas, fountains and planting above Interstate 5

captures.label: Plaza — Canyon Fountain
captures.description: A seated view from a red movable chair at the edge of the plaza, looking across the open space toward the sculptural concrete forms of Canyon Fountain. Taken at seated position. For optimum immersion and scale perception, please view this while seated.

captures.label: Canyon Fountain — Lower Edge
captures.description: A seated 360° VR view from the lower edge of Canyon Fountain in Seattle’s Freeway Park, looking toward its layered concrete walls, ledges and stepped forms. The fountain was out of operation when this panorama was photographed in autumn 2025, following a leak discovered in summer 2024. It returned to operation in May 2026 after repairs. Created from a still 360° panorama. Taken at seated position. For optimum immersion and scale perception, please view this while seated.

captures.label: Canyon Fountain — Sunken Area
captures.description: A 360° view from the sunken area of Canyon Fountain in Seattle’s Freeway Park. The surrounding concrete walls and stepped landforms create a strongly enclosed space, with the viewpoint set within the sculptural canyon. The fountain was out of operation when this panorama was photographed, following a leak discovered in summer 2024. It returned to operation in May 2026 after repairs. Created from a still 360° panorama photographed during autumn 2025.

description: Freeway Park occupies the air space above Interstate 5 in downtown Seattle. Opened in 1976, its linked plazas use board-formed concrete walls, raised planting beds and changes in level to create enclosed spaces above the highway. Evergreen planting and substantial water features give the park a distinct character within the surrounding city.

title: re:Invent Plaza
subtitle: A planted urban plaza centered on a sculptural fountain

captures.label: Seating Area — Sculpture Fountain
captures.description: From a seating area enclosed by planting, looking toward the water feature and Gerard Tsutakawa’s bronze sculpture Tonbi. Filmed during autumn 2025. Taken at seated position. For optimum immersion and scale perception, please view this while seated.

links.label: Block 20 site area — Washington Department of Ecology

description: re:Invent Plaza is part of Amazon’s Block 20 in downtown Seattle. Designed by Site Workshop and completed in 2019, the plaza faces 7th Avenue and the Spheres. Gerard Tsutakawa’s bronze fountain sculpture Tonbi forms its focal point. Planted edges enclose seating areas, while a pedestrian passage connects the plaza to a second water feature within the block.
